message: The other day, my kids were convinced that their plush toys would be crucial in any emergency scenario. 🧸 As I rolled my eyes, I realized their enthusiasm reminded me of the importance of making preparedness a family affair. We ended up creating a fun go-bag together, mixing essentials with a few of their favorite things. It was a sweet reminder that being ready doesn’t have to be all serious—it can also be a bonding experience! What’s your favorite way to involve your kids in family preparedness?
